source.query_policy: Nondeprecated active statements; preferred rank (per territorial scope for entity values), then latest nonfuture date for quantities. Whole-country quantities only, including explicit total-area or combined land/water area. Equal-ranked conflicting quantities are retained.
source.demographic_policy: Referenced P172/P140 statements with explicit unitless P1107 shares in [0,1] only; latest nonfuture observation per territorial scope, then rank per category. Missing categories/shares are never inferred; totals are not normalized. P3075 official religion is not a population breakdown.
